name: How long does it take to install trim and molding in a home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install trim and molding in a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a standard room, baseboard or crown molding installation typically takes one to two days from demo through finish carpentry and painting. Larger, multi-room projects or whole-home trim updates can take several days to a week or more. The schedule depends on profile complexity—such as multi-piece crown builds—and whether walls need drywall repairs before trim can lay flat. Having rooms cleared of furniture and flooring already set helps avoid delays during the carpentry phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room typically takes one to two days for installation, patching, and paint. Whole-home installations take several days depending on profile complexity.
